method: First stage simple bot, prep cycles equally; actual native random2 reward and duplicate tokens. Normal mode only, initial ownership equals selected20 cards. One native chosen reward based on fixed target deficits; no exchanges (at most2 duplicate tokens). Four templates per starter chosen on disjoint training seeds by stage2 tactical averaged over3 preparations. No holdout-dependent build search. Stage2 conditional on first-stage success; same sampled rewards and seeds across modes. Unchanged=starter; owned=template adapted to original holdings; rewards=template adapted to earned holdings. Missing copies replaced with legal starter cards. Full prep+final both stages, no human/browser test. Same second-stage deck during preparation/final.
